explication: GBrain is a controllable, provenance-aware memory system for AI agents. Its main workflow is an agent request entering through MCP or the CLI, passing through operation handling to a configurable persistence engine, and returning retrieved knowledge; optional capabilities include contextual retrieval, synthesis, and a typed knowledge graph. The README documents these product capabilities, while the source excerpts and index support only selected internal connections. Dashed edges mark documented product behavior or relationships not verified in sampled source.
